published.title: Manasseh, Amon and Josiah
published.summary: Manasseh and Amon turn Judah to idolatry. During Josiah’s reign Hilkiah finds the book of the law in the temple; Josiah renews the covenant, removes idols and keeps a great Passover before dying at Megiddo.
